verdict.rationale: Open-source licensing is a fair question for a SaaS identity platform, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows that a client SDK repository exists on GitHub (github.com/workos/workos-node, with install and retry details). It never states an open license, and nothing shows the WorkOS service's own source is readable under one. A public SDK repo with no documented license does not establish that the product's source is openly licensed.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
